adjudication.rationale: In Office365 `CalendarService.ts`, refresh uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and merges `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`. In sharing mode `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, which does not explicitly include `expiry_date` and (as a `z.object(...)`) will strip unknown keys. Therefore an `expiry_date` returned by the sync endpoint can be dropped, leaving the previous (possibly expired) `expiry_date` in `o365AuthCredentials`, and the subsequent `prisma.credential.update` persists that stale expiry value, plausibly triggering repeated refresh attempts.
